slices.expectation: generateTTS dispatches qwen-token-plan-tts to the new client. The client opens a pooled socket with Authorization header init, sends run-task then continue-task with the full text then finish-task, concatenates binary mp3 frames, and maps task-failed, abort, and timeout to an error class extending QwenTTSError. Hermetic vitest with stubbed WebSocket passes.
